prerequisites: source-native FSim burn probability in the frequency layer
six-bin conditional flame-length distribution or one sampled exact class
explicit wildfire_solar value profile or complete site failure-unit values
consumer event sampling and aggregation validated
financial caps and terms applied after physical loss with cap-binding checks

checks_required: validate annual event sampling and FSim frequency/severity separation
compare uncapped and capped annual loss on the selected value basis
verify per-event and aggregate caps against the physical value exposed
withhold reportable annual metrics if consumer cap-binding validation fails
cap_binding.action_if_fail: withhold reportable annual metrics until the downstream cap-binding and aggregation checks pass
